page.overview:
Who is Ada (Techno Sorceress)?

Later, when Peter asked Wong for help with some visions, he referred him to Ada, who turned out to be a sorceress who uses magic with a technological approach. Ada helped Peter interpret visions of her which were all connected to a mystical stone that kept appearing where he was.
